requirements_summary: Workload profile: mixed — interactive chat for CS agents (stateful), embeddings for search reindexing, offline reranking batch jobs.
Baseline steady-state target: ~80 QPS for chat (avg request = 150 tokens total: prompt+response) => sustained ~12,000 tokens/sec.
Burst/peak: up to 400 QPS observed during product launches (30-90s bursts) => peak ~60,000 tokens/sec; capacity must autoscale within 60s.
Latency SLOs requested: p95 <= 250ms for short-turn chat (<=64 tokens), p95 <= 800ms for long responses (>=256 tokens).
Throughput guarantee ask: reserved throughput for steady-state with committed GPU pool; failover to thinner model variant for degraded capacity.
GPU planning: preliminary sizing suggests reserve 8x A100-80GB equivalents for steady-state, autoscale headroom to 16 for bursts (10% safety margin).
Batching & caching: want automatic prefix/KV caching for session reuse and smart batching to reduce unit cost without violating latency SLOs.
Routing & fallbacks: multi-region routing (NA primary, EU DR), model variant fallback (redwood-vicuna-small) for emergency SLA preservation.
Security/compliance: require VPC networking, SSO/SAML, KMS integration (customer-managed key preferred), audit logs with 7-year retention for select events.
Evaluation criteria: demonstrate 30-minute uninterrupted 1x steady-state + 3 controlled burst simulations; confirm billing model for reserved capacity vs burst usage.
